newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Four wounded in West Bank shooting - Army radio.
newsitem.headline: Four wounded in West Bank shooting - Army radio.

text.p: Four people were wounded, one critically, in a shooting on a bypass road near the West Bank Palestinian-ruled town of Ramallah, Israel's army radio said.
It gave no further details. The army said it was checking the report.
Security sources said four people including a woman and a child were injured when their car came under fire near the village of Surda, 25 km (15 miles) north of Jerusalem.
The driver of the car told police the shots came from a Palestinian-registered car, Israel Radio said.
The driver managed to reach a gas station near Beit El Jewish settlement where he reported the shooting, the radio said.
